@notice Check whether a Supabase user has already voted this round.
 @param _userId Supabase user UUID.

params._endDate: Unix timestamp for when polls close.
params._startDate: Unix timestamp for when polls open.

params._userId: Supabase user UUID used for double-vote prevention.                      Hashed with electionRound so votes reset each round.

addCandidate(string,string).notice: Add a candidate to the current election round.

checkVote(string).notice: Check whether a Supabase user has already voted this round.

getDates().notice: Returns the current voting window timestamps.

resetElection().notice: Reset the election — increments the round, clears all candidates,         dates and vote records. A fresh election can then be configured.

setDates(uint256,uint256).notice: Set or update the voting window.

vote(uint256,string).notice: Cast a vote. Any connected wallet can vote — no approval needed.
